items.title: Housewife
items.best_for: dance studios, fitness instructors, fashion boutiques, hair and makeup artists, nightlife venues
items.idea: Dance studio: two instructors doing the choreography side by side, then the class joining in
ideas: Dance studio: two instructors doing the choreography side by side, then the class joining in
Fitness instructor: the routine slowed into a warm-up, then at full speed
Fashion boutique: one outfit, three ways, a new look on each beat drop
Nightlife venue: getting ready backstage to a full room, cut to the chorus
items.about: It’s the #1 song in the U.S. right now, and every Reel on its audio page is from the last two weeks. The format to copy is the @kevinbannier_ choreography, done as a duo. Creators also use it for “morning mantra” lip-syncs and night-out fit checks.

items.title: Angel Of My Dreams
items.best_for: tourism boards and tour operators, hotels, nail artists, jewelers, hair salons
items.idea: Tour operator: a POV from the train or boat window, one view per beat
ideas: Tour operator: a POV from the train or boat window, one view per beat
Hotel: the view from your best room at golden hour, then the room itself
Nail artist: a birthday set from bare nails to the finished design
Jeweler: a ring box opening in slow motion, turned toward the light
items.about: This is the most active sound on this week’s list. Nearly half the Reels on its page were posted in the last week. It suits “too pretty to be real” moments, and brands are already using it. @australia used it for a Melbourne city Reel, and jewelers are using it for ring unboxings.

items.title: November Rain
items.best_for: videographers and photographers, travel creators, car dealers and detailers, illustrators, vintage stores
items.idea: Videographer: your best shots from the year, color-graded, cut to the guitar solo
ideas: Videographer: your best shots from the year, color-graded, cut to the guitar solo
Travel creator: one trip told in rainy-window, road, and summit shots
Car dealer: a classic car on a wet road at dusk, then the keys handed over
Vintage store: 90s pieces styled one by one, with the year on screen
items.about: The month’s name is in the title, so it comes back every November. Creators use the guitar build for cinematic travel montages and 90s nostalgia. Some also post “then vs. now” memory edits, like “1992, we played it on repeat.”

items.title: All I Want for Christmas Is You
items.best_for: hair salons, nail and lash studios, gift shops, restaurants taking holiday bookings, travel agencies
items.idea: Hair salon: a December calendar filling up, ending on “book before it’s gone”
ideas: Hair salon: a December calendar filling up, ending on “book before it’s gone”
Nail studio: the holiday nail menu, one design per beat
Restaurant: the empty private room, then the same room set for a holiday party
Travel agency: “gift or trip?” with a wrapped box and a boarding pass
items.about: Every year, November 1 is when this song comes back, and the “it’s time” memes start. Service businesses are already using it for booking pushes. One salon’s “have you booked yet?”

items.title: Santa Tell Me
items.best_for: cafes, bookstores, candle shops, cinemas, home decor stores
items.idea: Cafe: the first holiday drink of the season, poured and topped in close-up
ideas: Cafe: the first holiday drink of the season, poured and topped in close-up
Bookstore: the holiday reading table set up, one book per beat
Candle shop: lighting each holiday scent, ending on the full lineup
Cinema: your holiday movie schedule shown as cozy seat-and-popcorn shots
items.about: The “it’s timeeee” countdown sound. Ten of the Reels on its page were posted October 26–29, mostly countdown clips and “time to watch Christmas movies” posts.

items.title: Underneath the Tree
items.best_for: restaurants and bars, home decor stores, gift and toy shops, event venues, local city guides
items.idea: Restaurant: the holiday decor going up overnight, revealed at opening time
ideas: Restaurant: the holiday decor going up overnight, revealed at opening time
Home decor store: a bare tree to fully styled in five cuts, ending on “comment SHOP”
Toy shop: this year’s most-wanted gift, unboxed, with a comment keyword for the link
Event venue: the room the day before and the day of your first holiday event
items.about: This is the brand-launch sound of the holiday season. In the last week it carried a restaurant’s giant polar bear unveiling, a city ice rink opening, and tree reveals with shop links. The hook is simple: “Christmas starts November 1.”

items.title: Hold On, We're Going Home
items.best_for: lash and brow studios, equestrian and sports coaches, gyms, real estate agents, coffee shops
items.idea: Lash studio: three recent sets, ending on “November bookings are open”
ideas: Lash studio: three recent sets, ending on “November bookings are open”
Sports coach: a calm Monday training session, from warm-up to first win
Real estate agent: walking up to a front door, then the keys in a client’s hand
Coffee shop: the morning regulars, one familiar face per beat
items.about: The song is climbing the U.S. Spotify chart again, and nine of its Reels on the page were posted October 26–29. It works two ways: relatable comedy skits and smooth “starting my week” clips. A lash studio is already using it for “November bookings are open.”

items.title: Blue Moon
items.best_for: hair salons, skincare and beauty brands, makeup artists, fitness studios, tourism boards
items.idea: Hair salon: a quick styling tutorial, one step per beat
ideas: Hair salon: a quick styling tutorial, one step per beat
Skincare brand: a night routine with your product in every shot
Makeup artist: a lip combo, liner to gloss, with shade names on screen
Fitness studio: a 15-minute workout with the timer on screen
items.about: A fresh sound that beauty creators picked up this month. Every Reel on its page is less than three weeks old. It’s used for self-care routines, lip-combo tutorials, and salon how-tos. @australia used it for a Brisbane skyline Reel.

items.title: Dame Hombro
items.artist: Bulin 47, Kevin Wai, Breyco En Producidera
items.best_for: estheticians and med spas, restaurants and bars, retail teams, dance studios, Latin food brands
items.idea: Esthetician: you, at a party, checking out everyone’s skin while everyone else dances
ideas: Esthetician: you, at a party, checking out everyone’s skin while everyone else dances
Restaurant: the kitchen crew doing the shoulder move before service
Retail team: the staff doing it on the shop floor before opening
Latin food brand: a product tossed hand to hand, landing on the beat
items.about: A dembow track that’s in the TikTok top 10 right now. The move is “dando hombro,” a shoulder shimmy, and teams are doing it together to start the week. One esthetician turned it into a joke about scanning everyone’s skin.

items.title: Everlong
items.best_for: independent retail shops, car detailers, contractors, high school and local sports teams, gyms
items.idea: Independent shop: the empty space on day one, then the full store today
ideas: Independent shop: the empty space on day one, then the full store today
Car detailer: a dirty interior to spotless, timed to the drum kick
Contractor: a gutted room to finished, one cut per beat
Gym: day 1 to day 100 of a member’s progress
items.about: The slow-building guitar is made for “how it started vs. how it’s going” stories. A Salem shop used it to show the empty building it moved into, then the finished store. Sports teams are using it for senior-night recaps.

items.title: Linger
items.best_for: cafes, photographers, pet groomers and pet shops, bookstores, knitwear and fall fashion brands
items.idea: Cafe: a fall afternoon shot on a digicam, from the window seat to the last sip
ideas: Cafe: a fall afternoon shot on a digicam, from the window seat to the last sip
Photographer: behind the scenes of a fall shoot, filmed on a digicam
Pet groomer: a dog’s before, during, and after, with a soft close-up at the end
Knitwear brand: one sweater worn on three fall days
items.about: The 2026 remaster is back on the U.S. Spotify chart, and Reels are following. Creators use it for fall digicam diaries and “my life is a movie” clips. It’s soft enough for slow, personal content.

items.title: Sunshine (Instrumental)
items.best_for: nutritionists and wellness brands, personal trainers, career coaches, pet businesses, family brands
items.idea: Nutritionist: one easy recipe in four steps, with ingredients on screen
ideas: Nutritionist: one easy recipe in four steps, with ingredients on screen
Personal trainer: “72 hours until race day,” with one training clip a day
Career coach: one piece of advice in a single on-screen sentence, then the reason
Pet business: a dog road trip with “as long as I’m included” on screen
items.about: An instrumental with no lyrics, so it sits under talking and on-screen text without competing. Its biggest Reels this week are quick tips: a hydration water recipe (643K plays) and a career tip for people over 50 (over 1M plays). Later also lists it for the “taking one for the team” group-role format.

analysis.week_summary: 'Housewife' by Tate McRae leads Instagram Reels this week (Heat 87). 4 seasonal or returning sounds are back (All I Want for Christmas Is You, Underneath the Tree, Santa Tell Me). The best opportunity right now is 'Housewife': high heat and not yet crowded.
key_takeaways: Reels × Ireland crossover: 'Housewife' (#1 in Ireland), 'Nicole Kidman' (#12 in Ireland), 'Angel of My Dreams' (#43 in Ireland). These are the strongest local signals.
10 of 14 tracked sounds are rising: move early on 'Housewife', 'Patient Zero', 'Nicole Kidman'.
'All I Want for Christmas Is You' already has 1M+ reels, so you need a strong hook to stand out.
Most major-label songs may be blocked for Business accounts: reuse the same formats with original audio or a voiceover.
analysis.ireland_signal: Also charting in Ireland: Housewife (#1), Nicole Kidman (#12), Angel of My Dreams (#43). Irish acts in the top 20: Fontaines D.C., Kingfishr, Amble. Good material for Irish-pride content.
